expected goals (xG) is a figure that adds a value to all shot attempts. This includes shots from open-play, direct free kicks and penalty kicks. In order to generate a figure that values probability of a goal being scored from a shot, parameters such as shot distance, shot angle, pressure on the player, opponent between the ball and the goal, body part when the ball is released from and the respective match situation are taken into account.&quot;,&quot;meaning&quot;:&quot;Shot-based xG tell how high the scoring probability of a goal shot is, taking into account many parameters. At player and team level, the shot-based xG indicate how many goals would have been statistically expected for the player or team on the basis of the goals scored. The comparison with the goals actually scored allows a statement to be made about the finishing efficiency.
